recruit.desk_body:
Interested in joining us? Here's how it works.

📋 **Before you apply**
Your application is private — only you and the officers can see it.

📝 **What we'll ask**
Your in-game character (class & role), level/CP, PvP·PvE experience, real availability, and why you want to join. Answer honestly — we're not after perfect players, just present ones.

⏭️ **What's next**
Tap **Apply** below to open your application. An officer gets back to you, and you chat with them in a private channel.

panel.title: ⚡ Kisk — quick actions
panel.body:
No commands to remember — click a button, pick from the menus, fill in the blanks:

📅 **Create an event** — dungeon, raid, battleground, PvP...
🏖️ **Report an absence** — let the legion know when you're away

Joining an event stays one click on its {tank} Tank / {heal} Heal / {dps} DPS buttons.{where}
panel.pin_tip: 💡 Pin this message, then use `/channels events: #… absences: #…` so the results are posted in their own channels instead of pushing the panel out of sight.

welcome_join.title: Welcome to the legion! 👋
welcome_join.body:
Here's how things work around here:
• `/profile set` — register your character (class, role), it will show up in parties
• `/events` — the scheduled events; sign up in one click (🛡️ Tank / 💚 Heal / 🗡️ DPS)
• `/event` — start your own run: dungeon, PvP, abyss...
• `/availability post` — tell us which evenings you can play this week

Have fun! ⚔️
